These are semantic coverage families, not a deterministic keyword checklist. Do not repeat an accepted quote with the same normalized economic identity and do not infer a fact or absence from silence. To this end, the Company closely monitors and responds to each risk factor.\nThe Company establishes global financial management standards, periodically measures customer’s and counterparty’s\nfinancial risk, and manages the risk with currency hedges and review of cash flows.\nThe Company also manages foreign exchange risk by monitoring foreign exchange rate fluctuations through local\nfinancial centers in the major regions (United States, United Kingdom, Singapore, China, Brazil, and Russia), which act\nas an agent for the subsidiaries in each region to manage foreign exchange transactions.
